关于城市广场的故事(A Story about the city square): 一篇关于城市生活的A2短文:杰克与本的经历和小计划。
Jack hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Jack and Ben had great fun there. Jack plays tennis with Ben every Sunday. Best of all, glass skyscrapers line the new district.
Both of them like rice and milk. Life is full of small surprises. Jack wants to be a nurse in the future. Also, the kitten made a cute sound.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the city square by bike. Jack usually has rice for breakfast. The city square is one of the best places in the city. For example, blue is in stock again.
The weather was sunny that day. Jack learned a lot about math. Jack wrote about the day in the diary.
